comments.author: Carbon Black
comments.body_html: I mean this started as my personal projects in SPT 3.10 but I decided to bring them to SPT 4.0 for others to enjoy, they are simple additions meant to encourage use of platforms and calibers I don’t see being used often enough or with too many limitations. SALCO does similar, and honestly more, but I try not to add anything they add or that others add. So far only the AK-15 seems to be the only duplicate that anyone’s made, and that was on request for someone. The mod opening description is “It’s just more guns, what else do you expect?”, so- what did you expect?
